author: grand canyon times
title: Scottsdale Area Chamber to host discussion on 2026 market and pharmacy trends
text:
The Scottsdale Area Chamber of Commerce announced on April 15 it will hold an interactive session focused on market insights, emerging trends, and the changing pharmacy landscape for 2026. The event aims to address key issues shaping employee benefits this year, including new strategies for managing health plans and important pharmacy developments that affect both costs and care.
This session is intended to give employers practical information as they make decisions about benefit programs in a shifting marketplace. Organizers say the discussion will offer forward-looking perspectives to help participants navigate changes in healthcare and benefits planning.
The Scottsdale Area Chamber of Commerce promotes a more inclusive business environment through initiatives supporting community prosperity, according to the official website. The organization also focuses on advancing community prosperity through advocacy efforts and business development projects, as reported by its official website.
Operating within the Scottsdale region, the chamber advocates for pro-business policies at city, county, and state levels according to its official website. It participates in collaborative efforts such as the East Valley Chamber of Commerce Alliance for advocacy work according to its official website.
Members have access to resources like networking opportunities and professional development programs offered by the chamber according to its official website. As businesses prepare for changes in healthcare policy and cost management strategies in 2026, events like this provide guidance from local leaders.
